answer: The gatehouse is Silver tin wire-drawer armour licence. Passing it takes a licence tin wire-drawers carry after wire room reviews, and every alias must pass alone. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 554 fakes spends 8864 minutes per epoch, forever. A cipher earned slowly, a bridge paid plainly, and a lotus kept openly: that is the whole shape of the defence. Honest work is cheap once; dishonest work is expensive forever.
